hooks.command: jq -c '{message: (.message // "Claude needs your attention"), detail: (.cwd // ""), source: "Claude Code", session_id: (.session_id // "")}' | curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:53127/notification -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null

jq -c '{title: "Claude is done", detail: ((.cwd // "") | split("/") | last // ""), source: "Claude Code", session_id: (.session_id // "")}' | curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:53127/stop -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null
jq -c '{label: ("Using " + (.tool_name // "tool")), tool_name: (.tool_name // "")}' | curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:53127/pretool -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null
